case_title: PEI RU ZHAO VS. MIRAN LIU

docket_entries.description: PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (SERVICE FEE $40 WAIVED BY SHERIFF) SERVED JUL-22-2022, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT LIU, MIRAN

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-07-2022 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO OCT-06-2022 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF PEI RU ZHAO IS PRESENT AND ASSISTED BY COURT CERTIFIED CANTONESE INTERPRETER EDWARD CHIU. DEFENDANT MIRAN LIU IS PRESENT. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $1,175.00 (WHICH INCLUDES COSTS) TO THE PLAINTIFF. DEFENDANT MADE A CHECK PAYMENT IN THE AMOUNT OF $1,175.00 TO PLAINTIFF DURING COURT. PLAINTIFF REQUESTS $6.00 OF THE COST OF COPYING FEES THAT HAS BEEN PAID TO THE SHERIFF'S OFFICE. DEFENDANT HAS MADE A CASH PAYMENT OF $6.00 TO PLAINTIFF IN COURT. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE OCT-6-2022 HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: D. AU. NOT REPORTED. (D506).
ORDER CASE CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT: PENDING SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.)

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF. NO APPEARANCES BY DEFENDANT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: D. AU. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
